description: This file defines an Android Activity class 'WordActivity' that displays a word and its definition, handles search functionality via the options menu, and manages navigation to other activities within the app.

classes.name: WordActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays a word and its definition, and manages search and navigation actions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, configures the ActionBar for API >= Honeycomb, retrieves data via URI and presents it in TextViews.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu, sets up the SearchView for API >= Honeycomb to handle searches.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, particularly initiating search requests and navigating back to the SearchableDictionary activity.
